stories.body: Nearly 200 nations miss COP31's Friday deadline in Antalya as the draft drops fossil-fuel mentions; talks resume Saturday.
stories.headline: Climate summit runs into Saturday with no deal

stories.body: Saudi-led coalition destroys three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh early Saturday, the second attack in days.
stories.headline: Three Houthi missiles shot down over Riyadh

stories.body: Russia fires 148 drones and 3 ballistic missiles overnight; 117 downed or jammed; a boy and a paramedic die in Kryvyi Rih.
stories.headline: Russia fires 148 drones overnight

stories.body: Magnitude 6.7, 34 km north of Junín, 108 km deep; no deaths; about 34 houses damaged, rockfalls on Carretera Central.
stories.headline: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake shakes central Peru

stories.body: Air Niugini PX19 Boeing 767, Hong Kong–Port Moresby, engine fire warning, lands Davao 00:08 local; 137 passengers and 9 crew evacuate by slides, no injuries.
stories.headline: Jet lands safely after engine-fire alert

stories.body: After Poland reports three airspace violations (two missiles and a drone), the NATO chief vows defence of Polish soil; the council meets Monday.
stories.headline: Rutte: NATO will defend every inch

stories.body: About 688,800 displaced by the Moyale conflict; about 50,000 fled into Kenya; the EU allocated €550,000 on 19 November.
stories.headline: ~700,000 displaced in southern Ethiopia

stories.body: After an 8-year voyage, the ESA/JAXA twin orbiters enter Mercury orbit on 21 November (insertion 18:24 UTC); the second mission ever to orbit Mercury.
stories.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury

stories.body: BTC about $58,300, lowest since 2024; about $2.4bn in futures liquidated in 24 hours; Fear & Greed index 12.
stories.headline: Bitcoin below $60,000

stories.body: Antonelli qualifies 1:33.893 but a 5-place grid penalty hands pole to Verstappen for the Saturday 20:00 local race.
stories.headline: Antonelli fastest, Verstappen on pole

stories.body: S&P 500 −3.7% to 6,910, Nasdaq −5.3%, Nvidia −14% on the day and −23% on the week (worst since 2008); about $7tn erased in the week.
stories.headline: Wall Street's $7 trillion week

stories.body: An Israeli strike kills three Palestinians in a vehicle carrying papers and food for World Central Kitchen.
stories.headline: Strike kills three in aid vehicle

stories.body: Tankers hit near Khasab, six attacks counted in a week; US–Iran talks stalled.
stories.headline: Tanker attacks keep Hormuz on edge

stories.body: Two Russian missiles and a drone crossed Polish airspace; NATO council meets Monday.
stories.headline: Poland counts three airspace violations

stories.body: 8 killed and 3 Dnipro bridges damaged in Friday's barrage, counted on Saturday.
stories.headline: Kyiv counts cost of Friday's barrage

stories.body: Italy approves Tesla's self-driving system for its roads.
stories.headline: Italy clears Tesla self-driving

stories.body: European leaders close ranks behind Poland after the airspace violations.
stories.headline: Europe closes ranks behind Poland

stories.body: Four more people killed across the Gaza Strip.
stories.headline: Four more killed across Gaza Strip

stories.body: The Saudi-led coalition hits Houthi targets after the Riyadh interception.
stories.headline: Coalition strikes back in Yemen

stories.body: The Quad firms up plans to meet in early 2027.
stories.headline: Quad firms to meet early 2027

stories.body: Japan and India deepen defence ties after 2+2 talks in Tokyo.
stories.headline: Japan, India deepen defence ties

stories.body: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall on the Odisha coast.
stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall

stories.body: Tokyo stays wary after the Shenzhen summit.
stories.headline: Tokyo wary after Shenzhen summit

stories.body: Rohingya react to the UN court's landmark ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against them.
stories.headline: Rohingya react to genocide ruling

stories.body: A US judge endorses a $7.25 billion settlement of the Roundup weedkiller cancer lawsuits.
stories.headline: $7.25bn Roundup deal approved

stories.body: Trump's Asia trip secures $17 billion in deals for US firms, including 20 Boeing 787 Dreamliners for Philippine Airlines.
stories.headline: $17bn in Asia deals for US firms

stories.body: A Walmart heir pledges $29.2 million to protect African wildlife parks.
stories.headline: $29.2m pledge for African parks

stories.body: A Miami court convicts a US-Haitian pastor over the 2021 assassination of Haiti's President.
stories.headline: Pastor convicted in Haiti plot

stories.body: Three El Salvadoran troops fighting gangs in Haiti die when a bomb detonates.
stories.headline: Three Salvadoran soldiers die in Haiti

stories.body: Caracas rejects the World Court's ruling on the Essequibo dispute with Guyana.
stories.headline: Venezuela rejects ICJ on Essequibo

stories.body: Damage checks after the Peru quake; about 34 homes are reported damaged, with rockfalls blocking the highway.
stories.headline: Damage checks after Peru quake

stories.body: The climate secretary sums up the mood as COP31's draft drops the fossil-fuel language.
stories.headline: 'No One Is Happy' at climate talks

stories.body: Somalia orders out the UAE envoy in a row over the opposition, deepening a diplomatic rift.
stories.headline: Somalia expels UAE ambassador

stories.body: Kenya's police order a headcount over Russia-linked ranks in its force.
stories.headline: Kenya counts heads over Russia ranks

stories.body: Children are hit hardest by Ebola as response teams race to contain the outbreak in Congo.
stories.headline: Children hit hardest by Ebola

stories.body: The Reserve Bank keeps its key rate at 7.25% as global markets sell off on AI and interest-rate worries.
stories.headline: South Africa holds rates at 7.25%

title: Saturday 21 November 2026 — The World in One Day
